source: local file: Screen Recording 2026-10-14 092120.mp4 (full landing page scrolled; no URL; analysed from frames, no DOM)

shadows: none conventional; white spotlight beam + violet radial glows

taste.name: Light Falls on the Product
taste.trigger: When connecting the hero CTA with the product shot
taste.decision: Drew a white spotlight beam from the CTA onto the dashboard over a static screenshot
taste.reason: The beam links click-here to what-you-get in one gesture and pulls the eye down
evidence: dashboard lit at its top edge in f00-f02

taste.name: Violet Means Act
taste.trigger: When choosing where the brand violet appears
taste.decision: Kept violet to CTAs, active toggle, check dots and one chart bar over violet backgrounds or tinted headings
taste.reason: On an almost colourless page the violet button is the only thing that asks to be pressed

taste.name: One Centre Line
taste.trigger: When laying out a long single-product page
taste.decision: Put every headline, CTA, pricing card and FAQ on one centred axis over alternating left/right rows
taste.reason: A single axis makes the page read as one argument; the eye never searches for the next start
evidence: hero, section titles, pricing, FAQ (~620 wide), closing panel all centred

taste.name: Black Floor, Lifted Cards
taste.trigger: When separating sections and grouping content
taste.decision: Chose pure black ground with long gaps and lifted tinted cards over section bands or divider rules
taste.reason: Empty black lets each section breathe; lifted cards show where to read without lines
